 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**The misspelled word is 'Perservrence'.**

__
 
• **The correct spelling would be 'Perseverance'.**
 
• The word '**Perseverance**' is a **noun** which means 'persistence in doing something despite difficulty or delay in achieving success'. **(धैर्य)**
 
 
• **For Example -**
 
• His perseverance in the face of challenges is admirable.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer would be** 'Perservrence'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**Let's understand the meanings of the other marked words - **

 
• **Conscientiousness - **the quality of wishing to do one's work or duty well and thoroughly **(ईमानदारी)**
 
• **Accommodate - **to provide space or a place for someone or something **(समायोजित करना)**
 
• **Exaggerate -** to represent something as being larger, greater, better, or worse than it really is **(अतिशयोक्ति करना)**
